newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mark falls below 63 yen, lowest since July 1995.
newsitem.headline: Mark falls below 63 yen, lowest since July 1995.

text.p: The mark dipped below 63 yen in late Tokyo trading on Wednesday in response to a sharp rise in the dollar/mark rate, dealers said.
Speculative mark sales against the yen and the dollar were fuelled by a lingering perception that the planned single currency, the euro, will be a weak and broad unit.
One bank dealer said the mark fell as low as 62.94 yen in late trading.
The mark was quoted at around 63.31 yen in early Tokyo trading on Tuesday.
